## 436. The schema-1 records whose laws schema 1 could not hold, migrated (DF3, batch A)

Board item DF, under RA. DF1 (§418) found law content in thirty schema-1 records, but schema 1 cannot hold a laws array, so DF1's record editors put that content into the statements and claims instead. DF2 (§426) left the migrations. DF3 migrates the thirty on main at `ba80cb002`, merged with main before landing. They make batch A of the 117 schema-1 records; the other 87 are batch B ([plan](../../../../2026-10-05-repository-reconciliation/architecture/df/DF3-PLAN.md)). The work is the AI's ([kit](../../../../2026-10-05-repository-reconciliation/architecture/df/README.md)).
